lines.text: Aquarius, saving the world is noble. Texting them back is also allowed.
lines.caption: text them back

lines.text: Aquarius, you can explain anything except what you want.
lines.caption: what do you want

lines.text: Aquarius, detachment is not peace. It's distance with good lighting.
lines.caption: distance with lighting

lines.text: Aquarius, being different is not a job you have to clock into.
lines.caption: clock out

lines.text: Aquarius, being different on purpose gets lonely when no one is let inside.
lines.caption: let someone in

lines.text: Aquarius, the feeling doesn't need a thesis. It just needs a minute.
lines.caption: no thesis needed

lines.text: Aquarius, they don't want your theory of love. They want your hand.
lines.caption: less theory

lines.text: Aquarius, the mind is a beautiful place to hide. It's still hiding.
lines.caption: still hiding

lines.text: Aquarius, friends first is lovely until you never get to second.
lines.caption: get to second

lines.text: Aquarius, not everything mainstream is wrong. Some of it is just nice.
lines.caption: some of it is nice

lines.text: Aquarius, disappearing for a week is not mysterious. It's just gone.
lines.caption: not mysterious, gone

lines.text: Aquarius, loneliness can look a lot like independence from the inside.
lines.caption: check the inside

lines.text: Aquarius, analyzing the feeling is a way of not having it.
lines.caption: just feel it

lines.text: Aquarius, the future can wait an hour while you eat something.
lines.caption: eat something

lines.text: Aquarius, you trust strangers online more than the person beside you.
lines.caption: turn to your left

lines.text: Aquarius, being misunderstood is not proof you are right.
lines.caption: not proof

lines.text: Aquarius, cool and distant reads as uninterested from the other side.
lines.caption: they can't read you

lines.text: Aquarius, the cause is real. So is your sleep schedule.
lines.caption: go to sleep

lines.text: Aquarius, someone wants to know the weird parts. Let them.
lines.caption: show the weird parts

lines.text: Aquarius, belonging somewhere won't make you disappear into it.
lines.caption: you can belong

lines.text: Aquarius, love is not a group chat. Someone has to go first.
lines.caption: go first

lines.text: Aquarius, the urge to vanish is a signal. Ask what it's pointing at.
lines.caption: what is it pointing at

lines.text: Aquarius, all day you cared about humanity. One human is still waiting.
lines.caption: one human is waiting

lines.text: Aquarius, your weird is a gift. It doesn't need to be performed.
lines.caption: stop performing it

lines.text: Aquarius, being hard to reach is not the same as being hard to lose.
lines.caption: easy to lose

lines.text: Aquarius, detaching from the pain also detaches you from the joy.
lines.caption: both or neither

lines.text: Aquarius, the best friend who feels like more probably is more.
lines.caption: it's probably more

lines.text: Aquarius, a big idea needs small habits to get out of your head.
lines.caption: small habits first

lines.text: Aquarius, a feeling is not a debate you have to win.
lines.caption: no debate needed

lines.text: Aquarius, you are kind to strangers and strict with yourself. Swap once.
lines.caption: swap once

lines.text: Aquarius, closeness won't erase you. It will just see you.
lines.caption: it will see you

lines.text: Aquarius, feelings are not bugs in the system. They are the system.
lines.caption: not a bug

lines.text: Aquarius, they aren't asking you to change. They're asking you to stay.
lines.caption: just stay

lines.text: Aquarius, being the outsider gets heavy when you're also closing the door.
lines.caption: you closed it

lines.text: Aquarius, the space you need is real. So is the space you leave behind.
lines.caption: mind the gap

lines.text: Aquarius, who are you when no one is watching you be original?
lines.caption: no audience

lines.text: Aquarius, leaving them on read is a choice, even when you meant to reply.
lines.caption: you meant to reply

lines.text: Aquarius, rebellion is easy. Consistency is the hard thing.
lines.caption: the hard thing

lines.text: Aquarius, what would it feel like to need someone, just a little?
lines.caption: just a little

lines.text: Aquarius, the world needs you rested more than it needs you right.
lines.caption: rested over right

lines.text: Aquarius, the future you're building has room for one more person.
lines.caption: room for one more

lines.text: Aquarius, a room full of people is not the enemy of who you are.
lines.caption: not the enemy

lines.text: Aquarius, aloof is a costume. They can tell.
lines.caption: they can tell

lines.text: Aquarius, being ahead of your time gets lonely in the present.
lines.caption: visit the present

lines.text: Aquarius, nobody can love the version of you that is always offline.
lines.caption: come online

lines.text: Aquarius, nobody gets a medal for needing the least.
lines.caption: no medal for this

lines.text: Aquarius, you leave before you can be left and call it being free.
lines.caption: that's not free

lines.text: Aquarius, you plan the future for everyone and skip your own tomorrow.
lines.caption: your tomorrow too

lines.text: Aquarius, intimacy is not conformity. It's just letting someone close.
lines.caption: not conformity

lines.text: Aquarius, rebelling against your own needs is not freedom.
lines.caption: needs are allowed

lines.text: Aquarius, the heart has logic too. Run the numbers on staying.
lines.caption: run the numbers

lines.text: Aquarius, community is not a crowd. It's the three people who check on you.
lines.caption: the three people

lines.text: Aquarius, they texted good morning. That's the revolution, small and quiet.
lines.caption: small revolution

lines.text: Aquarius, there's no shame in wanting what everyone else wants.
lines.caption: want it anyway

lines.text: Aquarius, freedom and being held are not opposites.
lines.caption: not opposites

lines.text: Aquarius, your brain is fast. Let your heart catch up.
lines.caption: let it catch up

lines.text: Aquarius, you ask everyone questions so nobody asks you any.
lines.caption: answer one

lines.text: Aquarius, a quiet day offline is not the same as disappearing.
lines.caption: offline is fine

lines.text: Aquarius, let someone see you before you've explained yourself.
lines.caption: skip the explanation

lines.text: Aquarius, the revolution will still be there after you drink some water.
lines.caption: drink some water

lines.text: Aquarius, you want to be known for your mind. Let them read your sky first.
lines.caption: mind first

lines.text: Aquarius, if you're done, say so. Fading out is not a release. It's a loose end.
lines.caption: say you're done

lines.text: Aquarius, a connection only you understand is not a connection yet.
lines.caption: not a connection yet

lines.text: Aquarius, say you need lots of space early. The right person will plan for it.
lines.caption: plan for the space

lines.text: Aquarius, people who think like you exist. You just haven't met them yet.
lines.caption: they exist

lines.text: Aquarius, the honest answer to how are you is allowed to be a feeling.
lines.caption: a real answer

lines.text: Aquarius, the experiment failed. Good data. Run a new one at 11:11.
lines.caption: good data

lines.text: Aquarius, freedom is your Sun. How you get close is your Venus. Learn both.
lines.caption: learn both

lines.text: Aquarius, release the need to be the most original person in the room.
lines.caption: not the most original

lines.text: Aquarius, give your friends the care you give your causes, and ask for it back.
lines.caption: ask for it back
